meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 当你给出目录、网址、笔记或“刚才做的事”,Claude 会提炼出可复用的操作流程,写成新技能文件 SKILL.md 存入 .claude/skills/;若该主题已有技能,则就地合并更新。它只创建或改进技能,不安装现成的外部技能。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”等,或要求把材料变成技能、更新已有技能时触发。若只想安装现成技能,则不触发。

say.text: /learn 这个仓库,把它的构建命令和坑写成技能。
say.note: 会读取目录结构,生成对应 SKILL.md。

say.text: 把我们刚才配环境的步骤变成技能。
say.note: 会回顾对话,提炼可复用流程后写入新技能。

say.text: 更新一下构建技能,加上今天遇到的坑。
say.note: 会读取原技能文件并就地合并新内容。

howto.what_en: Distills a directory, URL, pasted notes, or recent conversation into a reusable SKILL.md under .claude/skills/; if one for the topic exists, merges learnings into it. Creates or refines skills, does not install existing ones.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "/learn" etc., or asks to turn material into a skill or update an existing skill. It does not fire when the user wants to install a ready-made community skill.

say_en.text: /learn this repo and turn its build commands and gotchas into a skill.
say_en.note: Reads the directory and writes a matching SKILL.md.

say_en.text: Turn the steps we just did to set up the env into a skill.
say_en.note: Reviews the conversation and saves the reusable flow.

say_en.text: Update the build skill with the gotcha we hit today.
say_en.note: Reads the existing SKILL.md and merges the new notes.
